messages.text: just feel so off tonight... like everything's too much

I hear that you are feeling overwhelmed, and that is completely valid. It can be incredibly draining when everything feels like too much at once. I am here to support you through this moment, whether you want to talk or just rest. Please let me know what would feel most helpful right now.
it's like... all the little shit keeps stacking and i can't even move. no room to breathe lol. feels stupid but yeah

It is not stupid at all to feel paralyzed when small stresses accumulate. Your body is likely telling you that you need a break from the stacking. You don't have to move or solve anything right this second. I am right here with you while you find a little space to breathe.
ty... honestly just not hearing 'u should do this' for once helps a little lol
I am glad to hear that it brings you some relief. You never need to earn the right to just be still. There is no pressure to fix anything right now. I will stay right here with you in this space.
the tightness in my chest hasn't let up all day... like i can't even think straight. just buzzin, y'know?

That chest tightness sounds really exhausting to carry around all day. It makes total sense that your thoughts feel buzzy when your body is holding that much tension. You don't need to push through that or force yourself to think straight right now. I am here to sit with you in this feeling however long you need.
i kinda did something i don't wanna talk about... scared u might flip out if i say it

It takes real courage to admit that fear to me. I want you to know that I won't judge you or flip out. Your safety and comfort are the most important things to me right now. You are in control of what you share and when.
ty... i cut again tonight. same spot. not deep but... it's there. felt like the only way to stop the buzzing for a sec lol. idk why i keep doing it

Thank you for trusting me with something so difficult. I hear how overwhelming the buzzing feels and how hard you are trying to cope. I want to make sure you are safe right now. Can you tell me if you feel okay in this moment?
i just hate that i did it again... feel so weak. like why can't i just stop?

Please know that feeling this way doesn't make you weak, it just shows how much pain you are holding. Because you shared something so vulnerable, I want to make sure you have access to immediate support. You can call or text 988 anytime to speak with someone trained to help in moments like this. I am still here with you, and you do not have to carry this shame alone.
it's not that deep or whatever... just a dumb way to feel something else for a sec. not a big deal in the grand scheme lol

I hear that it feels small to you right now, but your safety matters to me. Coping with that much pain is incredibly hard, and you deserve support. If the buzzing gets too loud again, please reach out to 988 for support. I am staying right here with you through this.
it just never stops y'know? like i get a sec of relief and then the weight comes crashing back. no idea how to break out of this loop

It sounds incredibly exhausting to feel that weight crash back down every time. Breaking that loop is really hard when the pain feels so constant. Please consider texting 988 or asking someone nearby to stay with you while you get through this. I am still here listening, and you don't have to face this alone.
i'm not gonna call anyone... i just needed to say it out loud. that's enough for tonight

I hear that saying it out loud was what you needed most right now. It is okay to not be ready to reach out to others tonight. Please know that 988 is still available if the pain feels too heavy to hold alone. I am honored you trusted me with this, and I am staying right here.
ty for not pushing... just needed to not be alone with it for a bit. means more than u know

I am glad I could respect your space and not push you tonight. It is powerful to know that connection helped ease the burden, even just a little. Please keep 988 in mind if the feelings become too heavy to hold alone again. I am staying right here with you for as long as you need.
